about.title: About Us
about.heroDesc: At WarmTouch, we believe that the little things at home make the biggest difference.
about.storyP1: WarmTouch was born from a simple belief: your home should be your favorite place. In a world that moves too fast, we create handmade pieces that bring warmth, beauty, and calm into everyday life.
about.storyP2: We noticed how mass-produced home décor often feels cold and without connection. Our mission is to change that — by supporting local artisans and offering thoughtfully made products that stand the test of time.
about.storyP3: Every item we make carries a story, a purpose, and a whole lot of heart. Thank you for being part of ours.
about.missionDesc: To create handmade home essentials that combine beauty, function, and comfort — while supporting talented artisans and sustainable practices.
about.visionDesc: To be the leading brand for handmade home décor in the region — known for quality, trust, and the way we make people feel at home.
about.step1Desc: We carefully select natural, sustainable materials that are safe and long-lasting.
about.step2Desc: Skilled artisans craft each piece with attention to detail and passion.
about.step3Desc: Every item goes through rigorous quality checks to ensure perfection.
about.step4Desc: We pack with care and deliver on time — because you deserve the best.
about.teamSubtitle: Real people. Real passion. Real care.
about.valSimplicityDesc: Simple designs that bring peace and balance to your space.
about.valComfortDesc: Everything we create is made to make you feel at home.
about.valQualityDesc: We never compromise on materials or craftsmanship. Ever.
about.valTrustDesc: Honest communication, reliable service, and lasting relationships.
about.ctaDesc: Explore our collection of handmade treasures and bring warmth to every corner of your home.
